title: Sausage and Farro Skillet with Mushrooms and Delicata Squash
description: This quick, one-pan skillet recipe with Italian sausage and farro gets added flavor from mushrooms and winter squash, but other vegetables work great as well.
ingredients: 0.5 delicata squash - halved lenghwise, seeded, and cut into thin slices
2 tablespoons hot water, or as needed
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add sausage, onion, and squash. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onion and squash are softened slightly and sausages have browned on once side, about 5 minutes. Turn sausages and add frozen mushrooms; cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms have thawed, about 3 minutes.

Stir in vegetable broth and farro; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until farro is tender and sausage is cooked through, 10 to 15 minutes, adding hot water to the pan as needed to prevent the mixture from becoming too dry.
Lower heat and stir in Pecorino Romano cheese. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve immediately.
